title: Psalm 146: Put Not Your Trust in Princes
summary: The psalmist vows to praise the LORD as long as he lives and warns against trusting princes, mortal men whose plans die with them. Blessed is the one whose help and hope is the God of Jacob, Maker of heaven and earth, who remains faithful forever. The LORD executes justice for the oppressed, feeds the hungry, frees prisoners, opens blind eyes, lifts the bowed down, protects foreigners, sustains the fatherless and widow, and frustrates the wicked. The LORD reigns forever.

from.where: The Study Bible's introduction to the Psalms
from.text: on to a final crescendo in which every psalm from 146 to 150 begins and ends with Hallelujah, praise the LORD.

line: A vow to praise the LORD for life and a warning not to trust princes, whose plans die with them; the LORD reigns forever and cares for the oppressed, the hungry, the prisoner, the foreigner, the fatherless and the widow.
guide: Ask where you place your hope: a leader, a movement, a person with power. The psalm says they cannot save, and that they will die. Look at the people God cares for in verses 7 to 9; if you belong to him, they are your concern too.

stanzas.title: I will praise the LORD all my life
Do not trust in mortal princes
Blessed is the one whose help is the God of Jacob
What the LORD does for the vulnerable

verses.t: Hallelujah! Praise the LORD, O my soul.
I will praise the LORD all my life; I will sing praises to my God while I have my being.
Put not your trust in princes, in mortal man, who cannot save.
When his spirit departs, he returns to the ground; on that very day his plans perish.
Blessed is he whose help is the God of Jacob, whose hope is in the LORD his God,
the Maker of heaven and earth, the sea, and everything in them. He remains faithful forever.
He executes justice for the oppressed and gives food to the hungry. The LORD sets the prisoners free,
the LORD opens the eyes of the blind, the LORD lifts those who are weighed down, the LORD loves the righteous.
The LORD protects foreigners; He sustains the fatherless and the widow, but the ways of the wicked He frustrates.
The LORD reigns forever, your God, O Zion, for all generations. Hallelujah!
